description.main_zoo: The Main Zoo is a grassland-themed zoo region with 8 different biome types that can connect to other regions which unlock at higher levels in the game.
description.kujali_park: Kujali Park is a savanna-themed zoo region that connects to the Main Zoo through the transport station. It contains extra land, breeding slots, quests, and even a free giraffe. To compare Kujali Park to other areas, see Regions. Kujali is compatible with all main zoo biome types.
description.fir_grove: Fir Grove is a forest-themed zoo region that connects to the Main Zoo through the transport station. It contains extra land, breeding slots, quests, and even a free ice cream cart.  Fir Grove is compatible with all main zoo biome types. Although Fir Grove has no exclusive shops of its own, players can transport shops from the main zoo or Kujali Park into Fir Grove.
description.oceanside_zoo: Oceanside Zoo is a water-themed zoo region that connects to the Main Zoo through the transport station. It contains extra land, breeding slots, quests, exclusive shops and animals, and even a mixed-species water enclosure. Oceanside is compatible with all main zoo biome types. All Oceanside shops must be placed on water terrain and cannot be transported outside the Oceanside Zoo region.
description.polar_park: Polar Park is an ice-themed zoo region that connects to the Main Zoo through the transport station. It contains extra land, breeding slots, quests, exclusive shops and animals. Polar Park is compatible with all main zoo biome types. All Polar Park shops must be placed inside the Polar Park region and cannot be transported elsewhere.
description.rainforest_park: ainforest Park is a jungle-themed zoo region that connects to the Main Zoo through the transport station. It contains extra land, breeding slots, quests, exclusive animals, shops, decorations, paths, and terrain. The park's mixed-species jungle enclosure allows players to house any jungle species together in the same enclosure. Rainforest Park is compatible with all main zoo biome types. A rainfall animation is active inside the region and can be toggled on and off through the settings. All Rainforest Park shops must be placed inside the Rainforest Park region and cannot be transported elsewhere.
description.terrarium: The terrarium is a special region that does not connect to any other region. It contains its own exclusive quests, animals, and breeding. The terrarium is NOT compatible with any other region biomes but contains its own Rocky Desert and Leafy Thicket biome types. Terrarium shops can only be placed inside the terrarium and cannot transport to any other region.
description.aquarium: The aquarium is a special region that does not connect to any other region. It contains its own exclusive quests, animals, and breeding. The aquarium is NOT compatible with any other region biomes but contains its own Freshwater and Saltwater biome types. Aquarium shops can only be placed inside the aquarium and cannot be transported to any other region.
description.noctarium: The noctarium (Nocturnal House) is a special region that does not connect to any other region. It contains its own exclusive quests, animals, and breeding. The noctarium is NOT compatible with any other region biomes but contains its own nocturnal biome type. Noctarium shops can only be placed inside the Noctarium House and cannot be transported to any other region.
